candidate.kv_dtype: unsigned affine int4, two values per byte
candidate.granularity: independent K/V FP16 scale and zero per token and KV head
candidate.consumer: split-KV grouped decode with in-operand nibble dequantization

measurement.timed_operation: one progressive current-token append plus one complete decode
measurement.counter_pass: one post-terminal Nsight Compute replay per arm and geometry with only DRAM/L2/occupancy/register/spill evidence

gates.transition: all complete candidate outputs finite, exact shape/cardinality, relative L2 <= 0.02 versus dequantized-cache oracle; padded output exactly zero; request ownership disjoint
gates.performance: layer-weighted candidate median producer-plus-consumer time below matched control
gates.classification: component_positive only if both gates pass; otherwise component_reject

semantics: negative-slot padded producer no-op and zero decode output
prohibitions: no replay of predecessor component or prompt
